principle: An agent is judged on whether its output is acted on, never on how much it produces. An agent that only produces volume gets switched off.
problems: breaker: BROKEN RECORD — 7 finding(s) repeated three runs running (e.g. "Deploy smoke test (blank-page class, rendered DOM)"). Either they are not actionable or they are being ignored; the agent should say WHY instead of repeating itself.
